target.title: fix(tui): render delta-only assistant streams
target.body:
Closes #82988

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Gateway-backed and embedded TUI sessions could drop live assistant output when a runtime emitted incremental `delta` frames without also repeating the cumulative `text` snapshot. Users saw no progress until the final response, despite the runtime streaming correctly.

## Why This Change Was Made

A shared live-chat input normalizer now accepts snapshot-only, delta-only, and combined assistant events before both TUI backends enter the existing sanitization, merge, suppression, and projection pipeline. The branch was rebased and rewritten on current `main`; unrelated dependency override and lockfile changes were removed.

## User Impact

Streaming text appears incrementally in both normal Gateway TUI sessions and `tui --local`, including runtimes that emit canonical delta-only events. Commentary suppression, abort handling, buffer caps, and final-message behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts src/gateway/server-chat.stream-text-merge.test.ts` — 109 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.tui.config.ts src/tui/embedded-backend.test.ts` — 43 tests passed.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kwrjhsjn8geh91q5w6rnh5j3`: real Gateway + real tmux TUI showed the first `DELTA_` frame before the second frame arrived, then rendered `DELTA_ONLY_VISIBLE` while still streaming.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kwrjhsjn8geh91q5w6rnh5j3`: `pnpm check:changed` passed, including typechecks, lint, guards, and import-cycle checks.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
